In `LRUCache`, calling `get(key)` does not update the recency order of the key. When `get(key)` is called, the accessed key remains at its old position in `self.order` (or isn't moved to the most recent position), so when `put` is called afterwards, an item that was just used via `get` can be incorrectly evicted as the "oldest" item.
